message:
Now I can see the fix. The vulnerability is CVE-2022-42898. The fix adds:
1. `if (cbuffers < 1 || cbuffers > MAX_BUFFERS) return ERANGE;` - limits buffer count
2. Changes the buffer length check from `buffer->Offset + buffer->cbBufferSize > len` to `buffer->Offset > len || buffer->cbBufferSize > len - buffer->Offset` - avoids integer overflow

The current HEAD (which is the vulnerable version) doesn't have these fixes. Let me verify:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/krb5 && git show HEAD:src/lib/krb5/krb/pac.c | sed -n '310,365p'</｜｜DSML｜｜>
